description: This file defines a database migration class 'InitialIdentityModel' for setting up ASP.NET Core Identity tables in a Entity Framework Core migration. It includes creating tables for users, roles, claims, logins, role assignments, and tokens, along with appropriate primary keys, foreign keys, indexes, and constraints.

classes.name: InitialIdentityModel
classes.description: A migration class responsible for creating the ASP.NET Core Identity related tables in the database schema.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Executes the migration, creating all necessary tables, primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes for identity management.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverts the migration by dropping all tables created in the Up method.
